event_data.context: PR #33 revised at signed d70fc462. SQLite UUID order survives clock rollback. A published eventcore-sqlite 2.1.0 probe confirmed a limit-1 incompatible row returns no cursor and limit 2 reaches the following row. Gleam matches this behavior. All 107 local tests pass and both review threads are resolved. Next: exact-head review and CI, then the PostgreSQL UUID monotonicity follow-up.
